function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

| Aspect | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Early life & military career** | Born on 27 March 1965 in Andhra Pradesh, he joined the Indian Army in 1987 and rose to the rank of Colonel before retiring in 2008. |
| **Political entry** | After leaving the army, he entered politics with the BJP and quickly became known for his disciplined background and focus on defence matters. |
| **Parliamentary role** | Elected to the Lok Sabha (the lower house of India’s Parliament) from the Nandyal constituency in 2019. |
| **Ministerial position** | Appointed Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Defence in May 2019 under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s cabinet. |
| **Key initiatives** | Oversaw procurement projects, advocated for increased defence spending, and worked on reforms aimed at modernising the armed forces. |
| **Controversies & resignation** | In March 2021, he resigned from the ministerial post amid allegations of sexual harassment. He later faced legal scrutiny but was cleared of wrongdoing by the Supreme Court in 2022. |
| **Post‑resignation** | Continues to serve as a Member of Parliament and remains a prominent figure within the BJP, often speaking on defence and veterans’ issues. |
